plan: Use isolated Android Virtual Devices, native Android input, and browser assertions. Software CPU emulation is required because this WSL host has no /dev/kvm.
firstBoot: System watchdog restarted the UI process while software emulation and other audit jobs shared host memory. The device reached boot_completed=1, and Chrome and Gboard registered. Root requested a pause before retry under lower load. No app journey is claimed yet.

Appium UiAutomator2 supports native Android and mobile web on an emulator or device.

appium.decision: Native ADB input and Firefox WebDriver assertions are sufficient for these journeys if Android starts reliably. Appium does not provide an Android runtime or remove the need for hardware acceleration.

androidFallback.browser: Firefox 157.0.1 official Mozilla Android x86_64 APK
androidFallback.appJourney: Partial native verification on October 8. Navigation, keyboard input, retained code and server-confirmed Join passed. Waiting-room UI and settled landscape layout were not verified.
